verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships several embedded AI features you can hand work to. The AI Editor builds and edits ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence and flags gaps, and due-diligence reviews can be AI-assisted. These are narrow, feature-scoped helpers rather than a general in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks across the platform. Missing for 10: a general-purpose conversational assistant/agent, cross-module task delegation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the AI features.
